statement:
(a : ℕ → ℝ) (σ τ : ℕ → ℕ) (σsub : Subseq σ) (τsub : Subseq τ) (L M : ℝ) (hσ : SeqLim (a ∘ σ) L) (hτ : SeqLim (a ∘ τ) M)
  (hLM : L ≠ M) : ¬SeqConv a
name: Diverge_of_DiffSubseqLim
content: If a sequence `a : ℕ → ℝ` has two convergent subsequences, `a ∘ σ` converges to `L` and `a ∘ τ` converges to `M ≠ L`, then `a` is not convergent.
